failures.description: Failures you can construct a concrete path to. General worries without a constructed path do not belong here.

id.description: Short unique id such as F1, used to refer to this item later.

failure.description: What goes wrong, as the user would see it.

construction.description: The specific input, ordering or state and the code path that lead to the failure.

evidence.description: file:line or command output that supports the construction.

one_way.description: true if the failure is hard to undo once shipped.

undo_cost.description: What it takes to undo the damage.

basis.description: traced: followed the code path by reading it; ran: executed a command that shows it; inferred: reasoning without either.

id.description: Short unique id such as S1, used to refer to this item later.

how_to_verify.description: A command, read or test that would confirm or refute it.

basis.description: traced: followed the code path by reading it; ran: executed a command that shows it; inferred: reasoning without either.

unknowns.description: Possible problems you could not settle either way. Empty if none.

id.description: Short unique id such as U1, used to refer to this item later.

cheapest_experiment.description: The cheapest check that would answer it.

basis.description: traced: followed the code path by reading it; ran: executed a command that shows it; inferred: reasoning without either.

not_checked.description: Parts of the plan or code you did not examine. Empty if none.

would_change_my_mind.description: Evidence that would change your verdict. Empty if none.

need.description: The fact or result you would need to see.

why.description: How it would change your verdict.

questions_for_user.description: Questions only the user can answer, such as preferences, priorities or facts outside the code. Empty if none.

recommended.description: The answer you would pick and why.

caller_challenge.description: Set only when you disagree with a direction the caller has already chosen; otherwise null.

challenge.description: What you think is wrong with the chosen direction.

context_possibly_missing.description: Context the caller may have that you do not, which would make this challenge wrong.

cost_if_wrong.description: What it costs if the caller follows this challenge and you are wrong.

summary.description: 1-3 sentences. No praise, no restating the material.

verdict.description: ship: no constructed failure needs a change to the plan; revise: the plan holds but needs changes; rethink: the approach itself fails.
